'''Beytolim'''<ref name="SWVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a [[Pacithhip]]<ref name="SWCL" /> who, in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> was present outside<ref name="ROTS" /> the [[Galaxies Opera House]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] while it hosted a performance of the [[Mon Calamari]] ballet ''[[Squid Lake]]''.<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> As the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] ran into the [[opera]] house to meet [[Supreme Chancellor]]<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> inside, Beytolim was walking with two other<ref name="ROTS" /> Pacithhip<ref name="SWCL" /> up the opera house's steps.<ref name="ROTS" /> Beytolim had [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s and green skin and wore a [[Hair|fur]] [[Clothing|cloak]] with a spotted pattern to the opera house.<ref name="SWVE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beytolim's costume was first used during the filming of the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], where an extra wore it during the scenes set in the [[Outlander Club]] and its surroundings.<ref name="Webdoc">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> However, Beytolim is not visible in the final film<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and did not make an appearance until the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" />

The ''Revenge of the Sith'' opera steps scene was filmed on R Stage at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on Monday, [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> The Pacithhip did not receive a name in the film,<ref name="ROTS" /> but was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'', which was written by [[Adam Bray]], [[Tricia Barr]] and [[Cole Horton]].<ref name="SWVE" />
